verdict.rationale: INPI's docs confirm that holders and applicants of industrial-property rights have representatives (mandatários) on file and can update their details free of charge, so a sanctioned representative rail exists. Beyond that single mention, the pack does not explain who may act as a representative, how one is appointed or authorized, or what they can do for the company. Missing for 10: documentation of eligibility or accreditation rules for representatives, the appointment or power-of-attorney process, the scope of actions a representative can take, and any independent corroboration.
